acceptanceCriteria: All workspace package versions, release documentation, manifests, checksums, and artifact naming identify v0.2.94 consistently while preserving v0.2.93 as N-1.
The reviewed, synchronized main commit is the sole immutable source identity for the v0.2.94 tag and release workflow.
Candidate fresh installation and v0.2.93 to v0.2.94 upgrade pass in independent isolated environments with structured receipts.
Public v0.2.94 downloaded Release assets pass fresh install, v0.2.93 upgrade, manifest, checksum, and version consistency acceptance.
Failed release phases retain identity-bound evidence and recovery reuses only compatible successful phases without rerunning them.
Release workflow policy, source archive policy, tri-language documentation, and exact resource cleanup pass before close; unknown host or user-read status is not inferred.
goal: Advance AI Cockpit from v0.2.93 to v0.2.94 from the synchronized main revision and prove candidate plus public downloaded-artifact adoption.
intent: Publish v0.2.94 only after the Outcome handoff, four-direction convergence, and Issue #851 correspondence are complete.
outOfScope: Rust behavior changes unrelated to versioning or release acceptance
Provider tag or Release mutation before all pre-publication gates pass
Local source checkout or workspace binary as a substitute for public downloaded-artifact acceptance
Lifecycle refactoring unrelated to release evidence
